notes: S3.3 incorrectly strengthens ignored-input semantics into a claim that all registers remain unchanged. An ignored start while busy does not prevent a simultaneous valid frame bit from updating the working accumulator, and an ignored idle input does not prevent the one-cycle done pulse from clearing on the following edge. The trusted requirement only states that those ignored inputs themselves have no effect on frame state or published parity; it does not freeze unrelated state evolution. The final RTL implements the correct behavior and passes trusted simulation and bounded formal verification.
